note: Canonical master-layout topology. Reviewed standing-foot corridors plus OpenCV rasterized building/water exclusions; uncertain ground stays blocked. NEXUS panel filenames are swapped in the source pack; mapped by content here. Originals are preserved.

objects.name: Central Bank
objects.description: Deposits move Home money into the Bank. Bank deposits open at minute 10; the maximum Bank balance is ₹200. Withdrawals take 5 minutes.

objects.name: Raid Circle
objects.description: A crew has exactly 10 operators. Joining requires 5 completed challenges and 60 seconds in the circle. Each operator solves 5 questions; at least 5 must pass the 2-answer gate.

objects.name: Race Terminal
objects.description: Races open at minutes 30, 90 and 135. The first three correct answers receive ₹50, ₹30 and ₹20 from the race pool.

objects.name: Checkout
objects.description: Checkout ends your event participation and settles Home plus Bank. You cannot check out during a raid or while in jail.

objects.name: Leaderboard
objects.description: Final ranking uses Home plus Bank, then completed challenges, then the time that balance was reached.

objects.name: Tech Job Board
objects.description: CP, debugging and logic challenges. Starter jobs pay ₹5 once per operator; Standard jobs pay ₹10, and Expert jobs pay ₹80. Training has no payout.

objects.name: Logic Terminal
objects.description: Practice logic and debugging variants. Challenge answers and completion credit are validated by the server.

objects.name: CP Lab
objects.description: Competitive-programming challenges belong to the Tech Quarter pool.

objects.name: Debugging Lab
objects.description: Debugging challenges and non-paying training are validated by the server.

objects.name: Harbor Job Board
objects.description: SQL, networking and OSINT jobs use personal challenge variants. Answer submissions are checked by the server.

objects.name: Harbor Information
objects.description: The harbor connects to Central Exchange and Tech Quarter via marked transit routes.

objects.name: Data Centre
objects.description: Database challenges and training belong to the Data Harbor job pool.

objects.name: SQL Terminal
objects.description: SQL jobs use a query-result validator and personal variants.

objects.name: OSINT Terminal
objects.description: OSINT jobs use the event's provided evidence, not real-world attacks.

objects.name: Network Tower
objects.description: Networking challenges belong to the Data Harbor pool.

objects.name: Black Grid Job Board
objects.description: CTF, cybersecurity and forensics challenges use simulated targets. No task attacks a real system.

objects.name: Security Hub
objects.description: Every attempt, lock and money movement belongs to the authoritative game server.

objects.name: CTF Arena
objects.description: CTF jobs are simulated sandbox targets with server-validated flags.

objects.name: Challenge Terminal
objects.description: Personal challenge variants and training are part of the Black Grid job pool.

objects.name: Sandbox Station
objects.description: Security challenges run against event-provided sandbox systems only.

objects.name: Undercity Information
objects.description: Each operator owns one Home. Earnings arrive there first and can be exposed to burglary. Burglary requires a server-held lock and a validated challenge.

objects.name: Local Market
objects.description: Homes and burglary are governed by the event rules. There is no direct player-to-player money transfer.

objects.name: NEXUS Announcements
objects.description: NEXUS announces waves, races, bounties and Golden Hour clues. The default event lasts 180 minutes.

objects.name: Golden Hour Terminal
objects.description: Card Hunt at minute 70, Courier Chase at 115 and Server Sprint at 165 each use a fixed ₹100 pool.

objects.name: Event Terminal
objects.description: Golden Hour start points and clues are announced by NEXUS; the server controls event availability.

objects.name: NEXUS Information
objects.description: City announcements and event rules are available here. Every operator starts with zero wealth.

objects.name: Social Hub
objects.description: A public gathering place. The game does not permit direct money transfers between operators.
